jobs.title: VP, Business Group Chief Information Security Officer, SLAM
jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues \- experts in their fields \- who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients \- who are at the heart of everything we do.  



  

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.  



  

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.  



  

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.  



  

**Job Description:**

**VP, Business Group Information Security Officer, SLAM (BG CISO)**

  

**Job Purpose**

  

The Vice\-President, Business Group Information Security Officer, SLAM (BG CISO) serves as a senior security leader and partner to the Business Group leadership team and Business Group President. Acting as the senior security executive for the Business Group and the primary bridge between the business and enterprise Security function, the BG CISO provides independent oversight and challenge of cyber risk, resilience and security outcomes across the business group.  



  

The BG CISO is accountable for cyber risk, resilience, and security outcomes for Sun Life Asset Management, a global asset management platform with approximately $1\.6 trillion in AUM, established to strengthen collaboration across MFS Investment Management, SLC Management, Sun Life’s stake in Aditya Birla Sun Life Asset Management, the pension risk transfer business and the broader company.  



  

Reporting directly to the global Chief Security Officer, this role is responsible for ongoing emphasis on ensuring full capabilities across Sun Life Asset Management are consistently leveraged to deliver value and innovation. Direct and indirect reports include a team of \~ 10 security leads and advisors aligned to Asset Management business priorities, product/platform risk, incident readiness, and stakeholder engagement.  



  

The BG CISO partners closely with executives, technology leaders, risk partners, and the enterprise security team to protect critical assets, enable innovation, strengthen resilience, and ensure risks are understood and managed within the organization's risk appetite. The BG CISO is accountable for providing independent business\-aligned security oversight while enabling growth, innovation and transformation across the Business Group. The role translates complex cyber and security risks into business impacts and shapes strategy, investments, priorities, and operating decisions across the Business Group.  



  

**Scope, Decision Authority and Key Interfaces**

  

The Vice\-President, Business Group Information Security Officer serves as the senior security executive and trusted advisor to the Business Group President and leadership team. The role is accountable for cyber risk oversight, executive advisory services, security governance, resilience alignment, regulatory engagement, and independent challenge across the assigned business group. The Vice\-President translates enterprise security strategy into business\-relevant actions while ensuring cyber risk, resilience, regulatory obligations, and security priorities are appropriately considered within business decisions and transformation initiatives.  



  

The Vice\-President has delegated authority to establish business\-group security governance routines, direct security assessments, challenge risk decisions, require remediation planning, recommend security investment priorities, and escalate material cyber and resilience concerns through appropriate governance channels. Within approved authorities, the role provides independent advice and challenge regarding cyber risk, resilience, technology transformation, regulatory obligations, third\-party risk, and risk acceptance decisions. Where management disagreement exists regarding material cyber risk acceptance, the matter will be escalated to the Global Chief Information Security Officer for review and discussion with the applicable Business Group President before a final decision is made.  



  

The role is accountable for business\-group security oversight, executive advisory services, risk escalation, independent challenge, alignment of enterprise security services to business priorities, and operational ownership of Business Group Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) platforms and associated security outcomes. The role does not own enterprise cyber defence operations, enterprise security platform engineering, vulnerability remediation, incident response operations, or second\-line risk oversight except where responsibilities are expressly assigned. The Vice\-President works closely with Enterprise Security leaders to ensure Business Group CIAM capabilities remain aligned with enterprise architecture, security standards, resilience requirements, and regulatory obligations.  



  

Matters escalated to the Chief Information Security Officer would typically include significant cyber or operational resilience concerns, material breaches of risk appetite, major regulatory matters, unresolved management actions, significant third\-party security issues, material client commitments, or disagreements regarding risk acceptance, prioritization, or investment decisions.  



  

**Major Accountabilities**

**Strategic Security Leadership and Vision**

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer – Margin Technology - VP
jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


Engineer the future of global finance. At Citi, our Tech team doesn’t just support finance – we are helping to redefine it. Every day, $5 trillion crosses through our network. We do business in 180\+ countries operating at a scale few can match. From deploying advanced AI to helping shape global markets, we build systems that matter. Look to join a team where your work helps influence economies, your ideas can drive innovation and outcomes, and your growth is backed by mentorship, continuous learning and flexibility with potential hybrid work opportunities. Help solve real\-world challenges that touch millions and get the opportunity to build the future of finance with Citi Tech.

  

  

**What We do / The Team:**

  

  

Markets Operations Technology is going through an exciting phase of transformation in margin and collateral domain. We are re‑engineering our technology estate to achieve world‑leading performance and resiliency, enabling new capabilities in advanced execution, global market connectivity, and modernised post‑trade, clearing and margin processes. Our ambition is to deliver a seamlessly integrated, highly automated platform that drives outstanding client outcomes and accelerates growth across our global franchise.

  

  

**Role Overview/What will you do:**

  

  

As Lead Software Engineer in our global technology team, you will be working with a group of passionate engineers who build technical solutions to complex business problems.


You will be instrumental in shaping the future of our product and working towards a target state of a fully automated platform with minimal manual interventions. You will have an opportunity to participate in the whole spectrum of building a software solution, closely working with product teams and users. We expect you to contribute to our vision of building a strong engineering culture within our global teams.


This role is for someone who is a strong technologist, enjoys solving engineering challenges, has experience in building robust and high\-quality solutions, has excellent communication skills and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  

  

**Key Skills and Experience required \-**  



* Hands\-on professional software development experience
* Proficiency in programming in Java, Python, JavaScript or React
* Experience of building RESTful APIs using popular frameworks like Spring
* Experience of working with event driven systems, microservices, micro\-frontend UIs
* Experience of following TDD and clean code principles
* Proficiency with data structures, algorithms and SQL
* Able to independently work in fast paced and rapidly changing environment
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or engineering field involving software programming or systems engineering
  

  

**Any Beneficial / Nice to have skills and experience:**

* Experience of using cloud services such as AWS and distributed systems such as Kafka, Kubernetes, S3, DynamoDB, MongoDB or any other NoSQL database
* Experience of working in investment bank or financial services industry
  

  

This job description provides a high\-level review of the types of work performed. Other job\-related duties may be assigned as required.

jobs.title: Director, HR Transformation, Systems and Analytics
jobs.description:
**This is a hybrid position based out of our 243 Consumers Rd location in North York, with 4 days per week in office and 1 day remote.**

  

Lifemark Health Group (LHG) is a market leader in customized healthcare solutions. With over 20 years of service excellence, LHG is one of the largest, most trusted, and most comprehensive providers in Canada. As a national healthcare company, LHG employs over 5,000 highly trained clinicians, medical experts and team members in almost 400 locations coast\-to\-coast and continues to grow both organically as well as through acquisitions. Lifemark was acquired by Loblaw Companies on May 10, 2022\.

 **The Opportunity:**


We are seeking a strategic, collaborative, and results\-oriented Director, HR Transformation, Systems and Analytics to lead the evolution of Lifemark's HR operating model, technology capabilities, and people analytics function.


Reporting to the Vice President, People \& Culture, this role will provide strategic leadership across HR transformation, systems, process optimization, data governance, and workforce analytics. The Director will be responsible for developing and executing a roadmap that strengthens HR operational effectiveness, establishes scalable processes and controls, improves data quality, and enables more informed people and business decisions.


A key priority will be leading Lifemark's readiness for a future Workday implementation, ensuring that HR processes, data, governance, systems, and organizational capabilities are positioned for successful transformation. The role will also oversee the effectiveness and continuous improvement of existing HR platforms while identifying opportunities to leverage technology, automation, and responsible AI to improve efficiency and the employee and manager experience.


Working closely with People \& Culture leadership, Operations, Finance, Payroll, IT, Talent Acquisition, and Enterprise partners, the Director will translate business priorities into practical, sustainable solutions, lead cross\-functional initiatives, and build the capabilities required to support Lifemark's continued growth and evolution.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

**HR Transformation, Strategy \& Operating Model**

* Develop and execute a comprehensive HR transformation strategy and roadmap aligned with organizational priorities, business growth, and the evolving needs of the People \& Culture function.
* Lead the assessment and optimization of Lifemark's HR operating model, identifying opportunities to strengthen service delivery, accountability, governance, operational efficiency, and employee experience.
* Establish consistent, scalable, and well\-controlled HR processes across core employee lifecycle activities, including recruitment, onboarding, employee changes, position management, organizational changes, compensation\-related workflows, and offboarding.
* Lead current\-state process assessments to identify gaps, duplication, manual workarounds, inefficiencies, and operational or compliance risks.
* Oversee the development and implementation of standardized processes, operating procedures, governance frameworks, controls, and accountability structures.
* Establish mechanisms to monitor process effectiveness, compliance, and adherence to established controls.
* Identify and prioritize opportunities for process simplification, automation, and continuous improvement across People \& Culture.
* Lead transformation initiatives associated with organizational growth, acquisitions, integration activities, and evolving business requirements.
* Develop business cases, implementation plans, success measures, and executive recommendations to support transformation investments and priorities.

**HR Systems Strategy \& Workday Readiness**

* Provide strategic and functional leadership for Lifemark's HR systems landscape, ensuring technology capabilities support business requirements, HR operations, data integrity, and employee and manager experience.
* Develop and maintain an HR technology roadmap that balances current operational requirements, system optimization, future\-state capabilities, and long\-term transformation priorities.
* Lead the development and execution of Lifemark's Workday readiness roadmap, establishing clear milestones, accountabilities, dependencies, risks, and decision points.
* Assess organizational readiness across HR processes, data quality, governance, integrations, reporting, security roles, permissions, change impacts, and operating model requirements.
* Partner with Enterprise HRIS, IT, Payroll, Finance, and other stakeholders to align HR technology priorities, integration requirements, and future\-state system design.
* Oversee the prioritization, planning, testing, and implementation of enhancements to existing HR systems, including configuration changes, workflow improvements, reporting capabilities, and process automation.
* Establish appropriate governance and controls for HR system administration, access management, data maintenance, system changes, and issue resolution.
* Identify and address foundational process, data, and governance gaps that may impact the success of future HR technology implementations.
* Lead or support technology assessments, vendor engagement, business case development, solution design, and implementation planning as required.
* Ensure effective change management, documentation, training, and stakeholder readiness for HR system and technology initiatives.

* Develop and lead Lifemark's people analytics and reporting strategy, enabling reliable, meaningful, and actionable workforce insights to support business and HR decision\-making.

jobs.title: Chief Technology and Information Officer
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**  

  

For more than 130 years, The Salvation Army has served people in need in communities across Canada and Bermuda. Building on our roots as a world\-wide Christian church, each year we help more than 2 million people, providing necessities such as food, clothing and shelter. In addition, we support people experiencing unemployment, addiction and family challenges. We continually adapt and innovate to meet emerging needs and live out our mission, vision and values of hope, service, dignity and stewardship. As a faith\- and values\-based organization, we hire and serve people of all backgrounds and walks of life \- there is a place for everyone to belong here.


**Mission Statement**  

  

The Salvation Army exists to share the love of Jesus Christ, meet human needs and be a transforming influence in the communities of our world.


**Job Description:**

  

**POSITION PURPOSE SUMMARY**

  

The Chief Technology and Information Officer (CTIO) provides enterprise leadership and strategic direction for technology, information systems, data, cybersecurity and digital capabilities across The Salvation Army Canada and Bermuda Territory.  



  

As a senior organizational leader, the CTIO ensures technology strategy and investment support The Salvation Army’s mission, strategic priorities and operational needs. The role is accountable for technology, cybersecurity and resilience, enterprise systems, data and digital capability, technology operations, vendor partnerships, financial stewardship and the ongoing development of a high\-performing technology function.  



  

Working across a large, geographically dispersed and decentralized organization, the CTIO builds trusted relationships with leaders and stakeholders, balances enterprise consistency with operational realities, and drives technology adoption and organizational efficiencies in a way that reflects The Salvation Army’s mission, values and culture.

* Authentically lead in alignment with The Salvation Army’s mission, vision, values, Christian identity and spiritual foundations, recognizing that its social and community services are expressions of its higher purpose to share the love of Jesus Christ, meet human needs and be a transforming influence in communities.
* Ensure technology strategy, investment and decision\-making ultimately enable people, ministry and services to advance the mission.
* Contribute as an enterprise leader to organizational strategy, priorities and decisions beyond the technology portfolio.
Balance enterprise standards and priorities with legitimate operational, geographic and ministry\-specific needs.  
* 

  

Executive and People Leadership  



  

* Build and lead a high\-performing technology leadership team with clear accountability, a service\-oriented culture, strong succession and workforce planning, and the appropriate balance of internal and external capability.
* Provide strategic advice to senior leadership, translating complex technology, cybersecurity, data and digital issues into clear organizational choices, risks, opportunities and investment decisions.
* Lead significant organizational change associated with technology transformation, recognizing that successful adoption depends on people, process, culture and technology.
* Build strong relationships with operational leaders and users to understand needs and continuously improve technology effectiveness.
Model strong stewardship, integrity and accountability in leadership and decision\-making.  
* 

  

Enterprise Technology Strategy  



  

* Develop and execute a multi\-year enterprise technology strategy aligned with organizational priorities and mission.
* Stabilize and simplify the technology environment, strengthening reliability, integration, interoperability and sustainable adoption.
* Optimize existing technology platforms and investments before introducing new solutions.
* Improve connectivity and interoperability between systems to create a more seamless technology and user environment.
* Establish technology roadmaps, portfolio governance and prioritization that sequence investments appropriately and balance innovation, affordability, risk, organizational readiness and capacity.
* Lead targeted modernization and transformation where it creates clear organizational value, while assessing emerging technologies thoughtfully.
Oversee the technology project and investment portfolio, ensuring appropriate governance, stakeholder engagement and benefits realization.  
* 

Cybersecurity, Data and Technology Risk  



  

* Provide executive oversight of cybersecurity, information security, privacy, technology risk and resilience.
* Ensure appropriate controls, governance and compliance are in place to protect organizational information, systems and technology assets.
* Maintain effective disaster recovery, business continuity and technology resilience capabilities.
Ensure security, privacy, data protection and risk considerations are embedded in technology investments, vendor relationships and emerging technology adoption.  
* 

Technology Operations and Service Delivery  



  

* Ensure reliable, secure, responsive and cost\-effective delivery of enterprise applications, infrastructure, networks, cloud services, end\-user technology and service management.

jobs.title: Cloud Architecture & Engineering, Director
jobs.description:
At PwC, our people in infrastructure focus on designing and implementing robust, secure IT systems that support business operations. They enable the smooth functioning of networks, servers, and data centres to optimise performance and minimise downtime. Those in site reliability engineering at PwC will focus on enabling the reliability, scalability, and performance of organisational technology infrastructure. This will include working to automate processes, monitor systems, and resolve incidents to maintain a seamless user experience.**Meaningful work you’ll be part of**

  

As a Director, Cloud Architecture \& Engineering, you’ll work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping to solve business issues, deliver high\-quality client service and operational efficiency. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  

* You will play a pivotal leadership role at the intersection of cloud strategy, architecture, engineering, and client engagement.
* This role combines deep technical cloud expertise with strategic leadership, practice development, and team coaching.
* You will shape and scale cloud capabilities, guide clients through complex transformation journeys, and help drive PwC’s cloud first vision.
* You will be responsible for designing and governing enterprise grade cloud architectures while also driving advisory engagements, leading teams, strengthening client relationships, and contributing to the innovation pipeline for cloud\-based solutions and assets.
* This role requires a seasoned cloud leader who can operate fluently across business strategy, modern cloud architectures, and hands\-on technical depth—while mentoring teams and influencing both internal and client executives.

 **Cloud Architecture \& Engineering Leadership**

* Lead the design, governance, and implementation of end\-to\-end cloud architectures aligned to business goals and industry best practices.
* Architect scalable, secure, and cost optimized cloud solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* Develop cloud foundation blueprints, reference architectures, and reusable patterns.
* Oversee the design and optimization of Kubernetes platforms (EKS, AKS, GKE) and containerized environments.
* Guide the development and automation of cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, AWS CDK, ARM, etc.).
* Provide technical guidance on compute, storage, networking, security, identity, data services, and DevOps tooling.

 **Cloud Advisory \& Client Engagement**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to executive\-level stakeholders, helping them define and execute cloud strategies and operating models.
* Assess existing environments, develop modernization roadmaps, and oversee cloud migration programs.
* Lead proposal creation, solutioning activities, statements of work, and client presentations.
* Communicate complex technical concepts to nontechnical audiences clearly and effectively.
* Identify and prioritize client use cases and translate business requirements into architectural approaches and execution plans.

 **Practice \& Team Leadership**

* Build, lead, and mentor teams of cloud architects, engineers, and technical specialists.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning, experimentation, and cloud innovation.
* Recruit and grow diverse technical talent, ensuring strong career development and retention.
* Collaborate with practice leadership to define strategic direction, emerging offerings, and go\-to\-market assets.
* Lead initiatives that strengthen practice foundations: capability models, delivery frameworks, accelerators, patterns, and reusable assets.

 **Innovation, Delivery \& Thought Leadership**

* Lead technical innovation cycles to evaluate, test, and showcase new cloud technologies, tools, and architectures.
* Drive and participate in hands\-on cloud prototyping, labbing, and solution validation.
* Develop technical demos, asset\-driven solutions, and market\-aligned accelerators.
* Present at internal and external events, contributing to PwC’s thought leadership presence.
* Maintain active engagement with cloud provider alliances and product engineering teams to share early insights and influence product evolution.

**Experiences and skills you’ll use to solve**

 **Technical Expertise**

* Extensive experience in cloud architecture and engineering across AWS (primary), Azure, and/or GCP.
* Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, containers, microservices, serverless architectures, and modern DevOps practices.
* Hands\-on experience with IaC tools (Terraform strongly preferred), CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Argo, etc.), and automated deployment patterns.
* Strong understanding of cloud security, IAM, network segmentation, encryption, monitoring, cost optimization, and governance frameworks.
* Experience supporting modernization programs such as application migration, refactoring, API strategies, and technical debt remediation.
* AI\-assisted development and prior experience deploying agentic workloads and MLOps pipelines is an asset.

 **Leadership \& Consulting Skills**

* Demonstrated experience leading cloud\-focused teams and initiatives in a complex, multistakeholder environment.
* Strong executive communication skills suitable for client\-facing consulting environments.
* Ability to bridge business and technical perspectives and articulate value propositions, architecture decisions, and tradeoffs.
* Strategic mindset with a bias toward execution, innovation, and measurable impact.

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Significant cloud architecture and engineering leadership experience.
* Preferred: AWS Solutions Architect (Professional); Azure or GCP Architect certifications; Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or CKAD; Terraform Associate Certification.
* Ability to obtain Government of Canada **Security Clearance; Level 2 security clearance is an asset**.
*

* Collaborate across a matrixed environment and build alignment between business needs, digital priorities, technical strategy, and operational realities.
* Support investment planning, vendor discussions, technology evaluations, and business cases related to the Virtual Care platform.

---------------------

**Description de poste:**

**VP, Business Group Information Security Officer, Sun Life Canada**

The Vice\-President, Business Group Information Security Officer, Canada (BG CISO) serves as a senior security leader and partner to the Business Group leadership team and Business Group President. Acting as the senior security executive for the Business Group and the primary bridge between the business and enterprise Security function, the BG CISO provides independent oversight and challenge of cyber risk, resilience and security outcomes across the business group.  



  

The BG CISO, Sun Life Canada is accountable for cyber risk, resilience, and security outcomes for Sun Life Canada, one of the company’s core markets and a leader in health, wealth and protection, serving Clients across Canada through group benefits, individual insurance, wealth, advice and distribution channels.
  

  

The Canadian business is made up of complex ecosystems, requiring strong alignment with Canadian regulatory expectations, enterprise risk practices and digital/client\-service priorities. Reporting directly to the global Chief Security Officer this position will have direct and indirect reports including a team of \~ 10 security leads and advisors aligned to the Canada business and subsidiary priorities including oversight of Dialogue security, product/platform risk, incident readiness, and stakeholder engagement.  



  

The BG CISO partners closely with executives, technology leaders, risk partners, and the enterprise security team to protect critical assets, enable innovation, strengthen resilience, and ensure risks are understood and managed within the organization's risk appetite. The BG CISO is accountable for providing independent business\-aligned security oversight while enabling growth, innovation and transformation across the Business Group. The role translates complex cyber and security risks into business impacts and shapes strategy, investments, priorities, and operating decisions across the Business Group.  



  

**Scope, Decision Authority and Key Interfaces**

  

The Vice\-President, Business Group Information Security Officer serves as the senior security executive and trusted advisor to the Business Group President and leadership team. The role is accountable for cyber risk oversight, executive advisory services, security governance, resilience alignment, regulatory engagement, and independent challenge across the assigned business group. The Vice\-President translates enterprise security strategy into business\-relevant actions while ensuring cyber risk, resilience, regulatory obligations, and security priorities are appropriately considered within business decisions and transformation initiatives.  



  

The Vice\-President has delegated authority to establish business\-group security governance routines, direct security assessments, challenge risk decisions, require remediation planning, recommend security investment priorities, and escalate material cyber and resilience concerns through appropriate governance channels. Within approved authorities, the role provides independent advice and challenge regarding cyber risk, resilience, technology transformation, regulatory obligations, third\-party risk, and risk acceptance decisions. Where management disagreement exists regarding material cyber risk acceptance, the matter will be escalated to the Global Chief Information Security Officer for review and discussion with the applicable Business Group President before a final decision is made.  



  

The role is accountable for business\-group security oversight, executive advisory services, risk escalation, independent challenge, alignment of enterprise security services to business priorities, and operational ownership of Business Group Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) platforms and associated security outcomes. The role does not own enterprise cyber defence operations, enterprise security platform engineering, vulnerability remediation, incident response operations, or second\-line risk oversight except where responsibilities are expressly assigned. The Vice\-President works closely with Enterprise Security leaders to ensure Business Group CIAM capabilities remain aligned with enterprise architecture, security standards, resilience requirements, and regulatory obligations.

Aventus Development Corp. is looking for an experienced Director, Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A) to join our growing team. This is a new role with the opportunity to build and own our management reporting, budgeting and forecasting function from the ground up.
  
  

You’ll work closely with senior leadership and teams across the business to understand what’s driving the numbers and provide meaningful financial insights to support decision\-making.

* Build and own monthly management reporting, including consolidated financials, forecasts, variance analysis and KPIs.
* Lead the annual budgeting and ongoing forecasting processes.
* Partner with business leaders to understand results, challenge assumptions and identify risks and opportunities.
* Track development project costs, budgets, cash flow and cost\-to\-complete.
* Prepare lender reporting, covenant calculations and compliance reporting.
* Help implement our new accounting system, building reporting and automation to improve efficiency and reduce manual work.


**What You Bring:**  

* CFA or CPA designation, with 10\+ years of progressive finance experience, including 7\+ years in real estate development and construction.
* Strong experience with financial reporting, FP\&A, budgeting and consolidated financial statements across multiple entities.
* Solid understanding of development accounting, project budgets, cost\-to\-complete, lender reporting and covenant requirements.
* Proven ability to build management reporting, KPI dashboards and budgeting processes from the ground up.
* Advanced Excel skills with experience building structured, auditable financial models and scenario analyses.
* Strong communicator who can translate financial results into clear, actionable insights for senior leadership and work effectively across the business.
* Experience with ERP reporting, FP\&A tools, automation and/or Power BI is an asset.


**What Will Make You Successful:**  

* You take ownership and accountability and follow things through.
* You are a builder who enjoys creating reporting, processes and structure from the ground up.
* You dig into the numbers to understand the why, not just report the result.

We are looking for a Strategic Account Director who will be responsible for the strategic leadership, growth and long\-term health of a portfolio of TC Transcontinental Core Accounts representing more than $100 million in annual revenue.  

This position is currently open and reflects a new position created to support organizational growth.
